subject: Vendor security questionnaire kick-off + preferred form and evidence checklist
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@solerahealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Follow-up: security intake & preferred questionnaire (SIG vs CAIQ vs custom)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time on today’s call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- What we heard: SoleraHealth will evaluate Redwood for inference hosting of clinical summarization features (PHI in scope). You highlighted SOC 2 Type II requirement, GDPR data residency concerns for EU users, and a need to confirm technical controls around encryption and key management.
- Immediate ask from your side: vendor questionnaire and a list of evidence artifacts we can provide.

To move this forward, we can:
1) Complete a SIG/CAIQ prefill (fastest for tooling teams) — we can also add a small "PHI handling" appendix if you have custom questions.
2) Fill your custom vendor intake if you prefer (we can map answers to SIG fields).

Attached is a prefill workbook with suggested answers for SIG baseline and a redacted copy of our latest SOC 2 Type II report (2025). Can you confirm these items so we route the right team?

Specifically, could you confirm: 
- Do you want us to start with a SIG prefill or should we upload answers to your custom intake form?
- Who is the Solera security/contact owner for evidence intake (name + email)?
- Any required artifacts beyond SOC 2 (e.g., penetration test reports, encryption config snapshots, KMS attestations)?
- Target timeline for submission (we can aim for a 5-7 business day turnaround for a SIG prefill + evidence bundle).

I’ve looped Jordan for contract/terms questions and Avery for technical evidence (encryption, data residency).

Thanks — happy to schedule a 30-minute compliance deep-dive if that helps.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Technical Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: solera_prefill.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: SOC2-TypeII-Redacted-2025.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@solerahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vendor Intake <vendor-ops@solerahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up: security intake & preferred questionnaire (SIG vs CAIQ vs custom)

Hi Karthik —

Appreciate the recap and the files. A few clarifying points from my side: 

- Form preference: Solera’s security ops prefers SIG by default because our tooling maps easily to that. That said, we have a short custom appendix that focuses on PHI handling and our data processor expectations — we will need answers to the custom appendix in addition to the SIG prefill.
- SOC 2: our procurement team requires the most recent SOC 2 Type II, and it looks like the redacted 2025 report is fine to start. We’ll need an indication of the report scope (production infrastructure + inference runtime).
- GDPR/HIPAA: we have EU users for a subset of customers; please confirm whether Redwood supports EU data residency for inference and whether you have a DPA that covers EU data processing.
- Encryption & KMS: please confirm encryption in transit AND at rest, and whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys (CMK) or Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) patterns for Dedicated/Private deployments.

Also, can you point me to a short reference (customer case or architecture note) that describes on-prem/private deployment behavior for PHI workloads? Our compliance team will ask about network boundaries and audit log availability.

We aim to complete intake by end of next week; today I’m assigning this to our vendor ops contact (vendor-ops@solerahealth.com) and to me for technical clarifications.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Ruiz
Security & Compliance Program Manager | SoleraHealth
[Quoted text removed]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@solerahealth.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 13:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Follow-up: security intake & preferred questionnaire (SIG vs CAIQ vs custom)

Elena — thanks, that’s helpful. Short answers inline and next steps: 

- Start: we’ll populate the SIG prefill and append answers for your PHI appendix. We will return as a single bundle so your tooling can ingest the SIG fields and the custom appendix will be available as an addendum.
- SOC 2 scope: our SOC 2 Type II (2025) covers production inference runtime, model serving, and customer data handling for hosted & dedicated modes. We will include a cover note that explicitly states the scope details.
- EU data residency: yes — Redwood supports EU-hosted inference in select regions for Private/Dedicated and in our hosted offering via EU regional endpoints. We’ll list regions and available residency options in the prefill.
- Encryption / KMS: encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+/mutual TLS options) and encryption at rest are standard. For Dedicated and Private customers we support CMK via integrations with customer KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) — BYOK for on-prem can be discussed during the deep-dive.

Avery, can you confirm where we pull the following artifacts and whether we can include short config snapshots: 
- TLS configuration and cipher suite summary
- KMS integration guide or attestation (redacted)
- Audit log retention policy and example trace (redacted)

Elena — if you can confirm the vendor intake PDF we’ll map fields and propose the final delivery date. I’ve tentatively penciled in a 30-minute call next Wed (15:00 UTC) for a compliance deep-dive — does that work?

Karthik
Head of Technical Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: (prefill work in progress)]

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@solerahealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: security intake & preferred questionnaire (SIG vs CAIQ vs custom)

Hi Elena — short tech notes to address your asks: 

- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ for all control plane traffic; mTLS available for dedicated connections. At rest we use AES-256 with per-customer keys in hosted and dedicated. For Dedicated/Private we support CMK via AWS KMS/GCP KMS; for on-prem we provide a HSM/KMS integration pattern and can deliver a design doc.
- SOC2 artifacts: redacted SOC 2 PDF (attached in Karthik’s initial email) + supplementary attestation for inference runtime config. We can provide a short, redacted pen test summary on request (we work with external pentest vendor; full report available under NDA).
- Audit logs & residency: logs are available with timestamped events for model access and admin changes. Retention defaults to 90 days; extended retention is available as an add-on. For EU residency we host inference within EU regions and can route telemetry to customer-owned log sinks for Private deployment.

I’ll assemble the following for the SIG prefill bundle: 
- SIG prefill CSV with mapped answers
- SOC2 scope cover note (one-page)
- KMS integration overview (link + redacted attestation)
- Pen test executive summary (redacted)

We’ll send the bundle to vendor-ops@solerahealth.com once we have confirmation on the intake form mapping.

— Avery
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: (KMS integration overview link included in related_links)]

- Deep-dive: Wed 15:00 UTC works — I’ll send a calendar invite for a 30-minute call with our security engineer (Samir Patel).
